Index.meta_title: Alizé Residence | Luxury Beachfront Apartments & Condominiums in Da Nang
Index.meta_description: Discover Alizé Residence Da Nang. Exclusive luxury beachfront condominiums and penthouses on My Khe Beach, designed by AEDAS, developed by A&T Group.
Index.trade_wind_story: Trade Winds once guided legendary voyages across the ocean. Today, they return to the shores of My Khe, blending with the city's pulse. Alizé invites you to an artistic journey: returning home to your own private sanctuary.
Index.stone_desc: Natural stone façades were selected for their timeless appearance, durability and ease of maintenance, allowing the architecture to age beautifully over time.
Index.three_reasons: A SERENE COMPOSITION BY MY KHE BEACH
Index.real_life_location: “The art of a refined life is sometimes simply possessing a sanctuary quiet enough to listen to oneself.”
Index.location_heading: A PRIVATE SANCTUARY AMIDST THE PULSE OF THE OCEAN
Index.location_desc_1: Nestled at the prestigious intersection of Vo Nguyen Giap and Vo Van Kiet, Alizé emerges along the shores of My Khe as an exclusive private condominium haven. Here, natural ocean breezes carry the crisp scent of the sea and the invigorating vitality of Da Nang.
Index.location_desc_2: Touch the vibrant pulse of the city in a single step. Behold the endless horizon with a glance. From Alizé, journeys to the airport, downtown, and historic heritage lands unfold effortlessly.
Index.pool_quote: Instead of corridors, walking paths connect the apartments — making Alize Residence feel closer to a group of private homes than a standard...
Index.pool_quote_desc: An artistic icon shaping the spatial essence of Da Nang
Index.concept_desc: “From the invisible dances of the wind, AEDAS weaves a tangible language — where each architectural contour sings its own rhythm between the sea and sky of My Khe.”
Index.between_marbella: THE EPICENTER OF MY KHE BEACHFRONT
Index.between_marbella_desc: Positioned on the prestigious Vo Nguyen Giap coastal boulevard, directly overlooking the world-renowned My Khe Beach. Alizé offers effortless connectivity to Da Nang downtown, Son Tra Peninsula, and Hoi An Ancient Town, crafting a world-class resort lifestyle.
Index.this_year: A privileged sanctuary cherished amidst the winds
Index.timeline_love_bridge_desc: A romantic rendezvous along the poetic Han River adorned with love locks and the Carp-Dragon statue, offering panoramic sunset and festival firework views.
Index.timeline_admin_center_desc: The iconic lotus-shaped architectural tower rising above the urban skyline, connecting seamlessly to major administrative, financial, and diplomatic hubs.
Index.timeline_cham_museum_desc: The world's largest repository of antique Champa art, harmoniously blending French colonial charm with millennium-old mystical sandstone relics.
Index.timeline_marble_mountains_desc: A legendary ensemble of five limestone peaks rising from coastal plains, celebrated for mystical grottoes, ancient pagodas, and traditional stone craftsmanship.
Index.timeline_son_tra_desc: The pristine emerald crown of Da Nang where virgin forests meet the sea, home to Linh Ung Pagoda, misty Ban Co Peak, and the rare red-shanked douc langur.
Index.timeline_hoi_an_desc: A UNESCO World Heritage jewel of moss-tinted rooftops, cascading bougainvillea, glowing lanterns along the Hoai River, and world-renowned culinary heritage.
Index.timeline_my_son_desc: A thousand-year-old Hindu sanctuary nestled in a secluded valley, showcasing the enigmatic red-brick architectural triumph of the ancient Champa civilization.
Index.a_place_to_live:
A PLACE TO LIVE — TO

RETURN YEAR AFTER YEAR
Index.residences_range: RESIDENCES RANGE FROM 104 TO 244 SQ.M., OFFERING SPACIOUS SINGLE LEVEL AND DUPLEX LAYOUTS WITH GENEROUS TERRACES AND ROOFTOP SOLARIUMS.
Index.slide_1_desc: Private basement, direct outdoor access and a dedicated lower level.
Index.slide_2_desc: Two floors crowned with panoramic views and a private rooftop solarium — the ultimate expression of luxury living.
Index.slide_3_desc: Expansive living spaces with breathtaking sea views and unparalleled comfort.
Index.seventh_quote_1: INSTEAD OF CORRIDORS, WALKING PATHS CONNECT THE APARTMENTS — MAKING ALIZE RESIDENCE FEEL CLOSER TO A GROUP OF PRIVATE HOMES THAN A STANDARD COMPLEX
Index.seventh_quote_2: DIVE INTO SERENITY. OUR INFINITY POOLS BLEND SEAMLESSLY WITH THE HORIZON, OFFERING A PERFECT OASIS FOR RELAXATION AND REJUVENATION UNDER THE SUN
Index.seventh_quote_3: EACH PARKING SPACE INCLUDES PRE-INSTALLATION FOR OPTIONAL EV CHARGING.
Index.seventh_quote_4: A STATE-OF-THE-ART WELLNESS CENTER FEATURING PREMIUM EQUIPMENT AND SPA FACILITIES, DESIGNED TO NOURISH BOTH BODY AND MIND IN ABSOLUTE PRIVACY
Index.seventh_quote_5: METICULOUSLY CRAFTED MEDITERRANEAN GARDENS CREATE A LUSH, VERDANT ENVIRONMENT THAT CELEBRATES NATURE AND PROVIDES TRANQUIL SPACES FOR MEDITATION
Index.architecture_split_title: Gentle curves, cascading balconies, and continuous openings sculpted by the wind, allowing Alizé to move in harmony with the ocean's breath.
Index.at_group_desc_1: Carrying the aspiration to create enduring value in Vietnam's real estate market, A&T Group has progressively developed a diverse ecosystem of projects across high-potential provinces and cities. Each development represents a dedicated investment in prime location, master planning, architecture, and craftsmanship, aimed at delivering sustainable values for communities and future generations.
Index.at_group_desc_2: Alizé stands as one of those hallmark milestones – where A&T Group infuses its pioneering spirit into an extraordinary living sanctuary along My Khe Beach, sculpted by the wind, light, and the art of architecture.
Index.address_line_1: VO NGUYEN GIAP BLVD, PHUOC MY WARD
Index.address_line_2: SON TRA DISTRICT, DA NANG CITY, VIETNAM
Index.boutique_desc: A boutique gated community of 25 residences on Costa del Sol, designed around privacy, wellbeing and timeless Mediterranean living.
